# Report Round-Trip Fixtures

These `.bdinfo` files are synthetic serializer fixtures generated by `scripts/smoke-report-roundtrip.ps1`.

They do not contain real disc metadata or copied media data.

- `sample-snapshot-v2.bdinfo` is the canonical Snapshot v2 compressed JSON fixture. It is a ZIP archive with `snapshot.json`.
- `sample-xml*.bdinfo` and `sample-json*.bdinfo` are legacy proof-of-concept fixtures retained for best-effort loader coverage.

Regenerate them with:

```powershell
.\scripts\smoke-report-roundtrip.ps1 -BuildOutputPath .\BDInfo\bin\Release -UpdateFixtures
```
